game_concept: A tower defense set in Coastal Port – Lighthouse Point, the lighthouse on the point: the harbor master must handle rogue waves while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Discount Rules: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount.
theme: Coastal Port – Lighthouse Point: the lighthouse on the point
core_gameplay_loop: In Lighthouse Point, repeat each round: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount. Each round, rogue waves strike the harbor gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the profit value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the harbor gate from rogue waves in Lighthouse Point: keep the profit meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 80-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: profit drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 80-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 10 (extended tier): Discount Rules
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Discount Rules' (Week 3 slot 10), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Lighthouse Point'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how profit changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue waves in Lighthouse Point.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 80 seconds while profit > 0.
